programme.desc: The North Wind and the Sun collide over who's stronger. They set a bet, to see who can make the passing traveler take off his jacket first.

programme.title: Brother Sun and Sister Moon
programme.desc: Late night, GoGo and I-Go wait for their mother who’s at the market selling rice cakes. Meanwhile, her mother gets eaten by a tiger whom disguises as her mother and makes his way to the siblings.

programme.title: Three Little Pigs
programme.desc: Three little pigs decide to leave home and live separately for their own good. Little pigs each build a house to live in until a wolf makes an appearance.

programme.title: Here Comes Zooniclaus
programme.desc: When Santa Claus is frozen by Enes weather machine Pancake becomes Zooniclaus. With help from the Zoonicorns he delivers gifts and saves the holiday learning responsibility and teamwork.

programme.title: Easter Legs
programme.desc: Maple must learn to play the Zoonihorn and work as part of a team. Together with the others she helps guide the Easter Legs during their annual hunt discovering the value of cooperation.

programme.title: Road of a Different Color
programme.desc: After rain mixes all the colors on Rainbow Road Pancake tries to fix them. With help he learns that mixed colors can be beautiful and create something new rather than needing to be separated.

programme.title: The Bare Bird Bath
programme.desc: Kea bird bath keeps losing water so Darwin and Newts investigate. They discover the sun is causing evaporation and learn how heat affects water in nature.

programme.title: Rip Roaring Roller Coaster
programme.desc: Darwin and Newts build a roller coaster and learn how trains stay on track. They explore loops speed and safety while enjoying their exciting creation.

programme.title: X-Marks the Not
programme.desc: Gummy becomes obsessed with finding a hidden pizza treasure. His search disturbs everyone until friends create a fake treasure to satisfy him but he later finds a real one and trades it for a huge pizza reward.

programme.title: Saving Mr. Kronk
programme.desc: Mr Kronk tries to cook a special dish but Gummy keeps interrupting with helpful intentions. Despite the disturbances Gummy manages to assist in the end and the dish turns out successful.

programme.title: Night of the Living Leftovers
programme.desc: A leftover food monster keeps eating and growing larger. Gummy tries to train it but it becomes too big for the house. The gang must find a bigger place with enough food to keep it happy.

programme.title: Cassette
programme.desc: Oo we have found some old gems, lets create something cool and funky out of them.

programme.title: Coffee Filter
programme.desc: Who says coffee is the only thing filters are used for. See how we turn this day to day object into something fun.

programme.title: Crayons
programme.desc: Colouring isnt the only thing these crayons are good at Join Hepi and Briko as they blow your mind with creative and colourful DIYs

programme.title: Giants And Bigheads
programme.desc: Fred signs his friends up to help with the school parade hoping to get a day off. His plan leads to unexpected work and challenges as they must complete the tasks.

programme.title: Corkys Prince
programme.desc: Corky finds an alien frog that turns into a handsome boy. The strange visitor quickly forms a bond with her creating a surprising and magical situation.

programme.title: Dollar Sense
programme.desc: King Blanco loses his crown to the pigs. Axel and HTDT use a golden goose to trap them leading to a messy chase as they try to recover the crown.

programme.title: Single White Egg
programme.desc: Goldilocks pretends to be Arisa and takes over the library. Axel and HTDT use a machine to send her back and restore the real Arisa.

programme.title: Me Me Me
programme.desc: DeeDee and Nino try to visit the Doobydoos but the Mayor keeps stopping them with urgent requests. He asks for help choosing a sash and finding his mail. He also sends messages to Charlie and Tiggy delaying their plans.

programme.title: Get your skates on
programme.desc: Mayor de Pfeffel receives a long awaited package containing new roller skates. Excited he explains he could not skate before with his old pair. Now he is ready to learn and join the towns skating craze eager to show his new skills.

programme.title: The Rolling Rice Ball
programme.desc: WI-Go drops one of his rice balls in a rat hole and gets a handful of jewelry in return. Meanwhile, a greedy neighbor next door UGo hears the news.

programme.title: Stone Soup
programme.desc: WI-Go the traveler is starving and has nothing but his brain. He ends up making the most delicious soup in the world using a mysterious stone without using a single penny.

programme.title: Heungboo and Nolboo
programme.desc: Mischievous UGo takes all of his parents' property and kicks his younger brother GoGo out of the house. Meanwhile, a swallow bird brings a gourd seed to the eaves of a kind-hearted GoGo house, and soon, gourds containing gold and silver treasures opens on the roof of the GoGo's house.

programme.title: The Star Talers
programme.desc: In the cold winter, the kindhearted girl, GoGo, meets several people who feel sorry for her on her way home. A fairy queen appears in front of a GoGGo that distributes all her clothes and bread and shakes in the cold.

programme.title: Wake Up and Smell the Bathtub
programme.desc: Maple avoids taking a bath but in the Zooniverse she helps the Zoonicorns restore their unique scents after they are blown away. She learns the importance of cleanliness and caring for herself.

programme.title: I Can't Heeeear You
programme.desc: Pancake finds the Zoonicorns have lost their voices. He must learn to understand visual clues to help them. Through this he discovers new ways of communication and problem solving.

programme.title: The Tickle Tree Talks
programme.desc: Pancake and the Zoonicorns try to cheer up a sad Tickle Tree. They learn that sometimes simply listening and being present is enough to help a friend feel better.

programme.title: Wapiti's Wheely Good Waka
programme.desc: While preparing their waka for summer Darwin and Newts meet Wapiti using a wheelchair. They work together to make the waka accessible and learn about inclusion.

programme.title: KiwiFruit Valley Christmas
programme.desc: A storm ruins Christmas plans but Darwin Newts and Heni work together. They create a simple celebration and learn that friendship and care matter more than perfection.

programme.title: Banzai as a Kite
programme.desc: While flying kites Gummy builds an advanced one that lifts him into the air. With help from Harry gadgets it goes out of control and the group must act quickly to bring him safely back down.

programme.title: Hairy Harry
programme.desc: Harry suffers from dry skin and seeks help but receives a hair product instead. His hair grows wildly causing chaos and fun as the others enjoy it until Harry finds a way to fix the situation.

programme.title: The Return of the Alien
programme.desc: While using a laser Gummy accidentally triggers an alien event and goes on a wild ride. The experience teaches the group important lessons about responsibility and not misusing gadgets.

programme.desc: The long, freezing winter has arrived for both the Ants, who worked hard from Spring to Autumn, and the Grasshopper, who sang and played all along.

programme.title: The Tortoise and the Hare
programme.desc: The Hare, the fastest animal in the woods, and the tortoise, the slowest, compete in a race.

programme.title: The Boy Who Cried Wolf
programme.desc: The shepherd boy is bored of uneventfully peaceful days. One day, he gets an idea for a prank - to lie about seeing a wolf to his village people.

programme.title: Gold Ax and Silver Ax
programme.desc: Hardworking woodsman GoGo loses his only Ax in the pond. GoGo's cry for help summons the Mountain Spirit, who rewards for his honesty. Another greedy woodsman UGo hears the story, and heads to the pond himself.

programme.title: The Trouble With Cakes
programme.desc: Ganks Thiving arrives in the Zooniverse and Ene and Odessa search for Harolds favorite cake. They find too many cakes which begin to overflow everywhere. The friends must control the chaos and still find the perfect cake to share with Harold.

programme.title: Promis Dream
programme.desc: Odessa helps Promi remember a dream she keeps having. While exploring it she realizes that something she once thought was boring in the real world was actually enjoyable when seen differently. She learns to appreciate small moments with a new perspective.

programme.title: Opposites Attract
programme.desc: When the silly slide disappears Maple and her friends go searching for it. They discover it has been taken by the Nonicorns who are opposite versions of them. The friends must figure out how to deal with their tricky opposites and get the slide back.

programme.title: Darwins Big Air
programme.desc: Darwin wants to perform big jumps on his BMX bike so Heni and Newts help him practice. With their support he learns skills confidence and the importance of patience while improving his riding abilities.

programme.title: The Wobbly Way Home
programme.desc: Darwin and Newts take a shortcut home before dark. Using balance and teamwork they overcome obstacles along the way and learn how cooperation helps them reach safely.

programme.title: Gummerish
programme.desc: Harry hears a strange noise and finds Gummy speaking in reverse. Granny explains it can be fixed by retracing steps. Kala and Harry follow Gummy to mirror land and rescue him but accidentally bring back reversed versions of themselves.

programme.desc: At the Pancake House Kala and Harry cannot decide what to eat so Gummy orders everything. After eating they realize they cannot pay. Mr Kronk makes them work but chaos follows as pancakes overflow and create a mess across the place.

programme.desc: After watching a wildlife show Gummy believes he is a frog and prepares to live by the lake. Kala and Harry try to convince him otherwise and help him understand he can be himself without copying everything he sees.

programme.desc: DeeDee and Nino help Charlie build an obstacle course. Before finishing a bendy tube Charlie leaves for deliveries. Boris and Sandy are told to avoid it but are eager to play. DeeDee and Nino must make sure they stay safe until Charlie returns.

programme.title: Country Mouse and City Mouse
programme.desc: Country Mouse GoGo receives a letter from his urban friend UGo, and leaves for the city.

programme.title: The Ugly Duckling
programme.desc: Mama Duck WI-Go birthes ducklings. However, one duckling GoGo looks quite different from the other siblings. GoGo is constantly teased and discriminated for the look.. What could be GoGo's real identity?

programme.title: The Happy Prince
programme.desc: The south-bound Swallow sits on the Happy Prince statue. However, unlike its name the Prince statue is crying. The Swallow postpones his trip and decides to help the Prince.

programme.title: The Red Shoes
programme.desc: Poor Girl GoGo loses her mother one day. GoGo is adopted by her rich grandmother WI-Go. In the midst of luxurious but strict life, GoGo receives a pair of Red Shoes against her grandmother's rules.

programme.title: Pet in the Clouds
programme.desc: Maple wishes for a dog of her own but in the Zooniverse she learns that caring for a pet is not easy. Without help she struggles and understands the responsibility involved in looking after another living being.

programme.title: Revenge of the Burping Boulders
programme.desc: Pancake learns about being too loud when the Burping Boulders visit. They reveal they were chased away by something even louder. Pancake understands how noise can affect others and learns to be more mindful of his behavior.

programme.title: Valentune Day
programme.desc: Pancake struggles to decide who should receive his biggest Valentine. In the Zooniverse he reflects on his memories and creates a special song for Valentune Day learning the importance of expressing feelings thoughtfully.

programme.title: Babycritters Club
programme.desc: When Heni hosts a dance Darwin and Newts take care of baby animals. They learn about different habitats and what the animals eat while managing their responsibilities.

programme.title: Mirror Mirror
programme.desc: Darwin brings home a mirror and Kea sees her reflection. Thinking it is another bird she becomes fascinated and forms a bond with what she believes is a new friend.

programme.title: Gummolepsy
programme.desc: Gummy prepares for a drag race hoping to beat Granny Peters record. He works all night on the car but becomes sleepy. Despite this he insists on driving himself leading to a risky and uncertain race outcome.

programme.title: The Record
programme.desc: Gummy and the gang attempt to break a world record by making the largest ice cream sundae. They gather ingredients and work together but face challenges as they try to complete the massive creation successfully.

programme.title: Bowl More
programme.desc: With a new bowling ball Gummy imagines everything as a bowling alley. His actions cause chaos until he nearly hits a baby. Realizing the danger he stops just in time and learns to control his imagination.

programme.title: Rock
programme.desc: Hepi and Briko have some solid ideas about what we can make with rocks.

programme.title: Towel
programme.desc: Why throw the old towels away, Upcycling and reusing are Hepi and Brikos favourite thing to do

programme.title: Rope
programme.desc: Summertime is here. Hepi and Briko have the perfect plan to re use all this rope we have lying around.

programme.title: Super Thomas
programme.desc: Fred helps Thomas live his dream of becoming a comic book hero. With a flying metal suit Thomas experiences adventure and excitement while learning what it truly means to be a hero.

programme.title: Gelatina
programme.desc: For Fridays birthday Fred plans a celebration but Brains faces trouble when her shapeshifting pet returns. The unpredictable creature causes chaos as Fred tries to make the day special.

programme.title: Singin in the Brain
programme.desc: Axel invents a mind reading device that turns thoughts into songs. Soon he realizes knowing everyones secrets causes trouble and learns that privacy is important.

programme.title: All's Shell That Ends Shell

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: After another failed plan, the gang turns to Alya for ideas. However, Alya is distracted by a class pop quiz and decides to sit out of saving the school this time. Without Alya, the gang decides it’s better to also focus on their studies first. While Alya thinks this is her time to shine and redeem her old self, her grades still plummet. She then turns to the unthinkable: to cheat in her exam! Consequently, causing her to be stripped off of her prefect position.

programme.title: Dee The Series
programme.desc: Dee bersama adik dan ibunya Amy, memulakan hidup baru di KL apabila Amy mendapat kerja baru di sebuah kolej swasta. Bermulalah satu dunia baru untuk Dee yang penuh dengan muzik, gelak ketawa dan air mata.

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: Adam has a new plan: To have the whole school’s buy-in to save the school through a petition! To do that, they need to form a committee. However, the group quickly falls apart. Mal discovers that if they continue to pursue the petition, Nana’s sister will lose her job. As their leader, Mal decides to stop their pursuit completely. By the end of it, Adam finally finds out the company taking over the school is his father’s company!

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: The gang discovers that Megah Holdings is conducting an interview at school. It’s the perfect opportunity to… sabotage it! programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: Alya navigates through school as a normal student now, while Zizi sets out to find out what is Adam’s relationship with Dato Idris. Meanwhile, Puan Bariah has called Alya’s parents to school due to her recent bad behaviour. Mal ends up consoling Alya, revealing that he lost his father due to the pandemic. Zizi finally finds out that Dato Idris is Adam’s father. By the end of it, while Adam is heading home, he sees that an Upacara Pecah Tanah will commence soon.

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: The gang regroup and decide that they will do a public demonstration during the Upacara Pecah Tanah. Zizi, on the other hand, tells Adam to talk to his father about it. TerLetop suddenly posts that there’s a special exposé. Adam accuses Zizi for being the person behind the account. Zizi denies. The Upacara Pecah Tanah carries on as planned. By the end of it, the TerLetop account exposes Zizi as Dato Idris’s daughter. Dato Idris exclaims that actually, Adam is his son instead!

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: The gang is disappointed in Adam. He tries to explain himself, to no avail. Adam wants to win his friends back and asks for Zizi’s help. Mal apologises to Cikgu Aini after he finds out that she was trying to protect him from getting expelled. By the end, Adam discovers the person behind the TerLetop account is Arif!

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: Before the gang can save the school, they need to figure out why the school is closing down first. Through some snooping around, they find out that the school is being bought over by a snack company to build their factory! The school is in such a bad shape that it became very affordable. The gang know what they must do: Gotong royong to increase the value of the school. While Alya and Adam are serious about saving the school, their friends are goofing off, causing a riff among the group.

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: Adam has a new plan: To have the whole school’s buy-in to save the school through a petition! To do that, they need to form a committee. However, the group quickly falls apart. Mal discovers that if they continue to pursue the petition, Nana’s sister will lose her job. As their leader, Mal decides to stop their pursuit completely. By the end of it, Adam finally finds out the company taking over the school is his father’s company!

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: The gang discovers that Megah Holdings is conducting an interview at school. It’s the perfect opportunity to… sabotage it! Mal, however, is distracted by the gossip social media account, TerLetop, that exposed Cikgu Aini as Mal’s mother! Worse still, Adam didn’t back Mal up as his best friend. During the interview with Megah Holdings, Adam is shocked to find that the person being interviewed is actually his father!

programme.desc: Before the gang can save the school, they need to figure out why the school is closing down first. The gang know what they must do: Gotong royong to increase the value of the school. While Alya and Adam are serious about saving the school, their friends are goofing off, causing a riff among the group.

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: Adam has a new plan: To have the whole school’s buy-in to save the school through a petition! To do that, they need to form a committee. However, the group quickly falls apart. Mal discovers that if they continue to pursue the petition, Nana’s sister will lose her job. As their leader, Mal decides to stop their pursuit completely. By the end of it, Adam finally finds out the company taking over the school is his father’s company!

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: Mal, Alya, Arif, Nana, Endi and Zizi are ready to take on the new school year! But wait, they’re in for a surprise when their long lost friend, Adam makes a comeback! The gang is complete again! Or so they think. It’s form 4 and the gang is separated into science and arts streams. Best friends, Mal and Adam are separated and have to find a way to get back together. By the end of it, the gang are in for the biggest shock of their lives!

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: SMK is closing down! What will the gang do? Worst still, Alya hasn’t been feeling like herself lately. She has trouble focusing and keeps messing up simple tasks. Mal, on the other hand, is going through an identity crisis. He hates football now and really wants to quit, but it’s so hard. By the end of it, they come out stronger. They have a newfound inspiration to save the school!

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: After another failed plan, the gang turns to Alya for ideas. However, Alya is distracted by a class pop quiz and decides to sit out of saving the school this time. Without Alya, the gang decides it’s better to also focus on their studies first. While Alya thinks this is her time to shine and redeem her old self, her grades still plummet. She then turns to the unthinkable: to cheat in her exam! Consequently, causing her to be stripped off of her prefect position.

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: Alya navigates through school as a normal student now, while Zizi sets out to find out what is Adam’s relationship with Dato Idris. Meanwhile, Puan Bariah has called Alya’s parents to school due to her recent bad behaviour. Mal ends up consoling Alya, revealing that he lost his father due to the pandemic. Zizi finally finds out that Dato Idris is Adam’s father. By the end of it, while Adam is heading home, he sees that an Upacara Pecah Tanah will commence soon.

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: The gang regroup and decide that they will do a public demonstration during the Upacara Pecah Tanah. Zizi, on the other hand, tells Adam to talk to his father about it. TerLetop suddenly posts that there’s a special exposé. Adam accuses Zizi for being the person behind the account. Zizi denies. The Upacara Pecah Tanah carries on as planned. By the end of it, the TerLetop account exposes Zizi as Dato Idris’s daughter. Dato Idris exclaims that actually, Adam is his son instead!

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: The gang is disappointed in Adam. He tries to explain himself, to no avail. Adam wants to win his friends back and asks for Zizi’s help. Meanwhile, Cikgu Aini gets into trouble with the school principal because of the public demonstration at the Upacara Pecah Tanah. Mal apologises to Cikgu Aini after he finds out that she was trying to protect him from getting expelled. By the end, Adam discovers the person behind the TerLetop account is Arif!

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: Dato Idris is finalising the contract in Megah Holdings taking over SMK. Adam finally has the guts to confront his father. However, it’s no use. Arif revives the TerLetop account for one last hurrah. At the school, students, teachers and the public show up in support of SMK. Dato Idris finally caves in and tears the contract. Life in SMK resumes back to normal. Mal finally regains his old identity as a footballer. We also find out that Alya has been secretly gifting Mal cupcakes all along!

Through some snooping around, they find out that the school is being bought over by a snack company to build their factory! The school is in such a bad shape that it became very affordable. The gang know what they must do: Gotong royong to increase the value of the school. While Alya and Adam are serious about saving the school, their friends are goofing off, causing a riff among the group.

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: Adam has a new plan: To have the whole school’s buy-in to save the school through a petition! To do that, they need to form a committee. However, the group quickly falls apart. Mal discovers that if they continue to pursue the petition, Nana’s sister will lose her job. As their leader, Mal decides to stop their pursuit completely. By the end of it, Adam finally finds out the company taking over the school is his father’s company!

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: The gang discovers that Megah Holdings is conducting an interview at school. It’s the perfect opportunity to… sabotage it! Mal, however, is distracted by the gossip social media account, TerLetop, that exposed Cikgu Aini as Mal’s mother! Worse still, Adam didn’t back Mal up as his best friend. During the interview with Megah Holdings, Adam is shocked to find that the person being interviewed is actually his father!

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: After another failed plan, the gang turns to Alya for ideas. However, Alya is distracted by a class pop quiz and decides to sit out of saving the school this time. Without Alya, the gang decides it’s better to also focus on their studies first. While Alya thinks this is her time to shine and redeem her old self, her grades still plummet. She then turns to the unthinkable: to cheat in her exam! Consequently, causing her to be stripped off of her prefect position.

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: Alya navigates through school as a normal student now, while Zizi sets out to find out what is Adam’s relationship with Dato Idris. Meanwhile, Puan Bariah has called Alya’s parents to school due to her recent bad behaviour. Mal ends up consoling Alya, revealing that he lost his father due to the pandemic. Zizi finally finds out that Dato Idris is Adam’s father. By the end of it, while Adam is heading home, he sees that an Upacara Pecah Tanah will commence soon.

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: The gang regroup and decide that they will do a public demonstration during the Upacara Pecah Tanah. Zizi, on the other hand, tells Adam to talk to his father about it. TerLetop suddenly posts that there’s a special exposé. Adam accuses Zizi for being the person behind the account. Zizi denies. The Upacara Pecah Tanah carries on as planned. By the end of it, the TerLetop account exposes Zizi as Dato Idris’s daughter. Dato Idris exclaims that actually, Adam is his son instead!

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: The gang is disappointed in Adam. He tries to explain himself, to no avail. Adam wants to win his friends back and asks for Zizi’s help. Meanwhile, Cikgu Aini gets into trouble with the school principal because of the public demonstration at the Upacara Pecah Tanah. Mal apologises to Cikgu Aini after he finds out that she was trying to protect him from getting expelled. By the end, Adam discovers the person behind the TerLetop account is Arif!

programme.title: SMK
programme.desc: Dato Idris is finalising the contract in Megah Holdings taking over SMK. Adam finally has the guts to confront his father. However, it’s no use. Arif revives the TerLetop account for one last hurrah. At the school, students, teachers and the public show up in support of SMK. Dato Idris finally caves in and tears the contract. Life in SMK resumes back to normal. Mal finally regains his old identity as a footballer. We also find out that Alya has been secretly gifting Mal cupcakes all along!

programme.title: Best Of Pets
programme.desc: Another episode of Best of Pets with funny pet clips.

programme.title: Cute Pet Guide
programme.desc: The meerkat king from "Madagascar" is funny, but meerkats in real life are well-behaved, cuddly and they heal our hearts! Pocket sized pets are currently all the rage, but there are details you need to pay attention to when raising them. For example, hedgehogs are highly defensive, timid sugar gliders will harm themselves without being next to their owners, and cute guinea pigs like Norman from the movie "The Secret Life of Pets" are easily abandoned due to being easy to obtain and raise, etc. Don't worry, experts will teach you how to raise them! Come to a restaurant in Kaohsiung to get up close with Rocket Raccoon from "The Avengers"!

programme.title: Zoo Vet At Large
programme.desc: A lone cow has gone wild and escaped into a neighbouring field.Dr. Matt has been called in to lend a hand. The heifer " went wild" two months ago and various tactics are employed to get Matt close enough to get a good shot with his dart gun. But the wary cow wins the first round and escapes. Matt decides to return another day.

programme.title: The Dog Rescuers
programme.desc: Chief Inspector Cathy Hyde is on a warrant to access a property in Leigh, suspected of being involved in puppy trafficking. Cathy discovers two Jack Russell types and two Yorkshire Terriers. Tragically, they were too late one for one dog that had passed away and another has badly fractured leg. Will Cathy be able to provide the escape that these dogs desperately need?

programme.title: Cute Pet At Home
programme.desc: Brother Hui, who runs an amphibian and reptile store in Xinxing District, Kaohsiung City, has a wide range of knowledge in the field of reptiles. He started with red-eared sliders and gradually got in touch with tortoises, lizards, snakes and other reptile pets. In Brother Hui's brick-and-mortar store, the most special existence is the two store pets, the South American lizards. The male is called Meatball and the female is called Porkball. How did their fate with Brother Hui begin? Brother Hui, who has many years of experience in raising South American lizards, also generously share his breeding secrets. How to distinguish male and female South American lizards? How to keep them healthy? What's the secret to taming them? In this epsiode, we unpack the living environment of South American lizards and reveal the breeding guide!

programme.title: ...Make You Laugh Out Loud
programme.desc: No wonder dogs are man's - and women's - best friend, when they give us so much to laugh about! Daft dogs, singing dogs, disobedient dogs, dogs dressed up to the canines - they're all here, obligingly caught on camera doing something hilarious.

programme.title: Scruffts
programme.desc: Six dogs, six handlers, all competing in the world’s largest and most famous dog show: "Crufts".nnBut they are not the pedigree pooches who compete to be labelled "Best in Show". These are the loveable family pets competing to win the "Scruffts" title.

programme.desc: Another episode of Best of Pets with funny pet clips.

programme.title: Cute Pet Guide
programme.desc: The meerkat king from "Madagascar" is funny, but meerkats in real life are well-behaved, cuddly and they heal our hearts! Pocket sized pets are currently all the rage, but there are details you need to pay attention to when raising them. For example, hedgehogs are highly defensive, timid sugar gliders will harm themselves without being next to their owners, and cute guinea pigs like Norman from the movie "The Secret Life of Pets" are easily abandoned due to being easy to obtain and raise, etc. Don't worry, experts will teach you how to raise them! Come to a restaurant in Kaohsiung to get up close with Rocket Raccoon from "The Avengers"!

programme.title: Zoo Vet At Large
programme.desc: A lone cow has gone wild and escaped into a neighbouring field.Dr. Matt has been called in to lend a hand. The heifer " went wild" two months ago and various tactics are employed to get Matt close enough to get a good shot with his dart gun. But the wary cow wins the first round and escapes. Matt decides to return another day.

programme.title: The Dog Rescuers
programme.desc: Chief Inspector Cathy Hyde is on a warrant to access a property in Leigh, suspected of being involved in puppy trafficking. Cathy discovers two Jack Russell types and two Yorkshire Terriers. Tragically, they were too late one for one dog that had passed away and another has badly fractured leg. Will Cathy be able to provide the escape that these dogs desperately need?

programme.title: Cute Pet At Home
programme.desc: Brother Hui, who runs an amphibian and reptile store in Xinxing District, Kaohsiung City, has a wide range of knowledge in the field of reptiles. He started with red-eared sliders and gradually got in touch with tortoises, lizards, snakes and other reptile pets. In Brother Hui's brick-and-mortar store, the most special existence is the two store pets, the South American lizards. The male is called Meatball and the female is called Porkball. How did their fate with Brother Hui begin? Brother Hui, who has many years of experience in raising South American lizards, also generously share his breeding secrets. How to distinguish male and female South American lizards? How to keep them healthy? What's the secret to taming them? In this epsiode, we unpack the living environment of South American lizards and reveal the breeding guide!

programme.title: Cute Pet At Home
programme.desc: Genus Pterophyllum, commonly known as P. scalare, freshwater angelfish or just angelfish is a large tropical fish native to the Amazon River in South America.They have a laterally flattened body, making them suitableto live in the crevices of tree roots in rivers with smooth water flow, and feeds on aquatic insects. The water temperature should be maintained at 26℃, and should reach 27-28℃ when breeding. The fertilized eggs are then released and attached to water plants or rocks, and the couple will take care of them together. However, once the eggs are hatched, the bigger ones will eat the smaller ones, hence not suitable to be raised together with other small fishes.

programme.title: Zoo Vet At Large
programme.desc: Dr. Matt pays his weekly visit to Flamingoland, near Malton in North Yorkshire, and is called to inspect a new arrival, a male Asian Sarus Crane brought in as company to a resident female. programme.title: The Dog Rescuers
programme.desc: In Birkenhead, Inspector Anthony Joynes is accompanied by the police to attend an unlocked and empty property. Inside he finds Teddy, the terrified Terrier cross that has a flea infestation so bad that he's missing half his fur. One-year-old Teddy is incredibly nervous, but will he be able to overcome his fears and allow the RSPCA to offer him help?

programme.title: Cute Pet At Home
programme.desc: Sugar gliders have bodies similar to that of a mustelid, and has a long, curly tail that cannot grab anything. Males are larger than females, measuring 25-30 cm long from nose to tail. Their fur is thick and soft, generally bluish-gray in color, but can also be yellow, tan, or white. The area from their nose to the middle of their back is black, while their abdomen, throat and chest are creamy white in color.

programme.title: Cute Pet At Home
programme.desc: Guppies in the wild aren't as beautiful as we see them in the aquarium. Many think they are mosquitofishes, but in reality, wild guppies and mosquitofishes were originally introduced from abroad for the purpose of preventing and treating malaria. However, unlike mosquitofishes, they are not seen everywhere in the wild. Instead, they were introduced into the aquarium market. Because guppies have genetic variability, especially the changing colors and patterns on their tail fins, their original wild patterns and colors have gradually been forgotten by everyone.

programme.desc: Policewoman So-eun stands in as the mother of a kidnapped child. The kidnpaper demands to negotiate with her as 'So-eun' and not as the stand-in for the kidnapped child's mother...

programme.title: Decibel
programme.desc: A former navy commander receives a threatening call who claims to blow up a stadium with a sound-responsive bomb. He must face the secret he left buried in the deep sea to track this terrorist down.

programme.title: The Hot-blooded
programme.desc: 4 friends gave up on Taekwondo and part ways after being asked to lose on purpose in a trial. Years later, they decided to take on a local gang realizing their hometown is threatened.

programme.title: Return of the Mafia
programme.desc: 10 years ago, the mafia family welcomed the entrepreneur Dae-suh as the son-in-law. They set up a company and Dae-Suh becomes the president. The family plot a conspiracy against him...

programme.title: Collectors
programme.desc: A legendary treasure hidden in Seoul's royal tomb sparks fierce rivalry as the exacavators and others with secret agendas race to outwit each other for the king's relics. Who will prevail?

programme.title: Sisters on the Road
programme.desc: After her mother's death, Myung-eun meets her sister Myung-ju. They do not share the same father and decided to travel together to find Myung-eun's father. A secret of her father reveals...

programme.title: Once We Were Us
programme.desc: Former lovers Eun-ho and Jeong-won unexpectedly reunite on a flight to Korea, giving them a second chance to reminisce about their past and share long-buried words with each other.

programme.title: Joseon Chefs
programme.desc: A nobleman who has passed the national civil service exam meets the self-proclaimed best chef in Joseon, falls into the world of gourmet food, and sets out to find the life he truly wants.

programme.title: Miracle in Cell No.7
programme.desc: A mentally challenged father who's wrongly jailed for the murder of a young girl reunites with his young daughter in the prison.

programme.title: The Unfair
programme.desc: A protest against urban renewal leads to death of a cop and a teen. The boy's father was arrested for the cop's death. A young attorney is assigned to defend the father.

programme.title: Split
programme.desc: Cheol-jong was once a legendary bowler, but an accident ended his career. He later teams up with an autistic genius bowling player Young-hoon and bookmaker Hee-jin to make money.

programme.title: The Man From Nowhere
programme.desc: A quiet pawnshop keeper with a violent past takes on a drug-and-organ trafficking ring in hope of saving the child who is his only friend.

programme.title: Dark Nuns
programme.desc: A boy is possessed by an evil spirit and his life is at risk. 2 nuns embark on a dangerous ritual and are determined to save the boy at all costs, no matter the risks or consequences.

programme.title: The Whistleblower
programme.desc: A disgraced Korean researcher claims to have successfully cloned human embryo stem cells. However, the results were revealed to be fabricated along with other unethical practices later.

programme.title: The Priests

programme.title: The Favor

programme.title: Love Clinique

programme.title: La Trepadora - S01:E001
programme.desc: Victoria Guanipa, asegura ante Genara que es la dueña y señora de Catarrana. Hilario Guanipa ordena a sus peones derribar la alambrada que delimita su hacienda porque midieron mal los linderos. Yosmir y Eugenia Alcoy del Casal, la hija menor de Fernanda, se conocen casualmente, pero el encuentro es desafortunado para el muchacho. Pablo va a dar un paseo a caballo, pero el animal sale a toda carrera sin que él pueda controlarlo. Victoria le da alcance al caballo donde va Pablo y lo detiene la pareja se simpatiza de inmediato, él se presenta como Pablo Martínez. Pablo advierte a Felipe que nadie debe saber que él es realmente Nicolás Del Casal.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje - S01:E98
programme.desc: Patricia aterrada, porque Celso quiere matar a su hijo Gregorio. Fausto molesto ordena vigilarla. Camila, cuenta a la Madre Isabel su tristeza por no haber conocido a su mamá ni en fotos. Se comunica con su primo Henry y éste le informa una dirección a la que decide asistir y también Max acude a una extraña llamada. Elda, recibe flores de Alfredo, teme que Luciano la descubra.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje - S01:E99
programme.desc: Fernando amenaza a Jeli con quitarle al niño, pero Leandro le advierte que él es su padre. Fausto espera a su hijo Gregorio, lo golpea, lo bota de la casa y decide quitarle todas sus pertenencias y beneficios. Ezequiel opta por encerrar a Julia; Gregorio viene a llevarse a su esposa, los encuentra Celso, enfurecido y drogado, y los ataca hiriendo a la joven.

Alberto se va a la biblioteca, no puede vivir sabiendo lo que su madre hizo y no es capaz de aceptar. Se escucha un disparo y todo parece indicar que Alberto se suicidó. Lorena, enardecida, culpa a Gertrudis de lo sucedido y el Jefe corrobora la muerte de su hijo. Gertrudis cae de rodillas, destrozada, gritando como fiera herida.

programme.title: El Desprecio - S01:E53

programme.title: La Trepadora - S01:E002
programme.desc: Victoria que está desnuda explica a Pablo (Nicolás) por qué se quedó sin ropa; el joven le da su camisa para que pueda salir del río. Hilario aprovecha cualquier oportunidad para galantear a Florencia. Por órdenes de Hilario, Zambrano a compaña a Pablo y Felipe en la cacería, pues debe vigilarlos. Victoria reta a Pablo a demostrar su puntería; él quiere como premio un beso de ella. Rosendo asegura a Florencia que a Hilario Guanipa a veces es mejor tenerlo lejos.

programme.title: La Trepadora - S01:E003
programme.desc: Hilario advierte a Victoria que no confía en Pablo porque presiente que el joven oculta algo. Victoria lee una nota que le dejara Pablo (Nicolás) asegurándole que volverán a verse y pidiéndole que lo espere.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje - S01:E100
programme.desc: Celso desquiciado veja y se burla de Fausto, éste dispara al pecho del amante que cae al instante. Fausto va hacia su oficina, diciendo a todos que no ha pasado nada. Camila, en el lugar de los hechos, trata de convencer a Patricia que huya pues todo indica que ella es la asesina de Celso.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje - S01:E101
programme.desc: Patricia, llora, negando haber matado a Celso. Fausto manipula a sus hijos para convencerlos de que su madre es la asesina y debe entregarse. Camila declara muy elocuente su versión de los hechos, y luego cuenta a Ezequiel que mintió para hacer pagar a Patricia por un delito que no cometió, tal cual se lo hicieron a su madre.

programme.title: Abigail - S03:E030 - Episode 30
programme.desc: María Begoña sin piedad le pregunta a su gemela si sigue enamorada de Carlos Fernando. Mariana desgarrada le suplica a su madre que le cuente toda la verdad a su padre. Abigail está desconsolada con el desprecio de Carlos Alfredo.

programme.title: Corazón Traicionado - S01:E119
programme.desc: María Lourdes comparece ante el Juez Echeverri y se entrega por el delito de corrupción y aceptar sobornos de Gertrudis; entrega una carpeta con documentos que prueban lo que dice para hundir a la señora Corona con ella - Gertrudis se burla de las acusaciones de Alberto y niega, una vez más, ser una asesina. Alberto se va a la biblioteca, no puede vivir sabiendo lo que su madre hizo y no es capaz de aceptar. Se escucha un disparo y todo parece indicar que Alberto se suicidó. Lorena, enardecida, culpa a Gertrudis de lo sucedido y el Jefe corrobora la muerte de su hijo. Gertrudis cae de rodillas, destrozada, gritando como fiera herida.

programme.title: Corazón Traicionado - S01:E120
programme.desc: Alberto llega al parque donde está Lorena con Norma e Ignacio. A él le parece que ya es tiempo del perdón y le cuenta lo que hizo con Claudio y Gertrudis, siguiendo el consejo que ella misma le dio; ahora se siente aliviado y listo para continuar. Alberto, arrodillado ante ella, le propone matrimonio a Lorena con un anillo en sus manos. Ella acepta feliz. "El que perdona la ofensa, cultiva el amor…" Fin.

programme.title: Climate Impact Asia - S01:E01 - Sea Level Rise
programme.desc: By 2100 over 1 billion people on Earth will live in low-lying coastal zones. 70% of these will live in Southeast Asia, one of the most vulnerable regions in the world to climate change. The next decade will be the most critical for the future existence of these societies.

programme.title: Climate Impact Asia - S01:E02 - Tsunami Costal Lab
programme.desc: Natural hazards remain a constant challenge for over 400 million people who live in low lying communities built along major mega delta regions in coastal zones. Events like typhoons and tsunamis threaten their very survival.

programme.title: Climate Impact Asia - S01:E03 - Volcanic Field Lab
programme.desc: Many people now know that climate change is real, that they see the data or they see the observations for themselves. What's needed now is a sense of urgency. We have within the next decade exceedingly important decisions to make.

programme.title: Climate Impact Asia - S01:E04 - Food Security
programme.desc: Rice, it's a staple food for many in Asia. It provides 1/3 of the energy in the average Asian diet and is the income source for more than 500 million people. programme.title: Breakthrough - S01:E58 - The West Is Burning
programme.desc: How did the western United States become a hotspot for unwieldy and devastating forest fires? Learn how the history of forest management and loss of public trust, coupled with climate change, have led to the conditions driving mega-fire nearly year-round.

programme.title: The Secret Lives of Sharks - S01:E02 - Hammerhead Shark
programme.desc: Travel to the Bahamas as Andy Casagrande attempts to place a fin camera on the elusive hammerhead shark… what could possibly go wrong?

programme.title: The Secret Lives of Sharks - S01:E03 - Tiger Shark
programme.desc: Ever wondered how a tiger shark hunts and feeds on its prey? Wildlife filmmaker Andy Casagrande travels off the coast of North Carolina to document never before seen behavior of one of the most misunderstood sharks in the world.

programme.title: Breakthrough - S01:E51 - Return of the Wolves

programme.title: Breakthrough - S01:E00 - Reefs Of Hope Extended Version
programme.desc: With new state-of-the-art tools and technologies that include curious underwater vehicles and hydrodynamic modeling, scientists have hope of better understanding the threats to coral communities while finding the source to restock reefs worldwide.

programme.title: Wild Ones - S01:E08 - Masters of the Sky
programme.desc: So many words describe the many ways that birds fly – pelicans and kestrels soar but owls fly silently. Parrots flock, vultures swarm and eagles swoop. programme.title: Wild Ones - S01:E09 - Disguised

programme.desc: They may be small but don’t be fooled - micro predators can be deadly. programme.title: Breakthrough - S01:E92 - Superpredators
programme.desc: For thousands—or even millions—of years, they ruled the food chain. And they still fascinate us. Creatures synonymous with the hunt: Saber Teeth, Mega Jaws, even a Tyrant King. How did they win evolution’s race—and what brought their reign to an end?

programme.title: Breakthrough - S01:E49 - Flight of the Dragon Mission Update
programme.desc: Witness this historic flight, from the first manned launch from the US in nearly a decade to the first splashdown attempt since the Apollo era.

programme.title: Breakthrough - S01:E69 - Voyage to Venus
programme.desc: For the first time in decades, NASA is sending two new missions to Venus designed to study and explore the planet’s atmosphere and earth-like composition. Together, DAVINCI and VERITAS will provide a new, 360º view of Venus -- its history, and perhaps a window into Earth’s past as well.

programme.title: Breakthrough - S01:E75 - Artemis First Launch
programme.desc: This is an inside look at NASA's groundbreaking Artemis Program, the spacecraft, and the people who will bring humanity one step closer to the moon, Mars, and beyond.

programme.title: Breakthrough - S01:E94 - Artemis II Ready for the Moon
programme.desc: Explore the rockets, landers, vehicles, and space capsule paving the way for future Artemis missions to the lunar surface. And meet the engineers—and the machines—behind NASA's Commercial Lander Payload Services (CLPS) missions, which are revolutionizing humanity’s relationship with the Moon.

programme.title: The New Frontier - S02:E08 - First Light
programme.desc: For an instrument first developed as recently as the 17th century, the telescope has travelled a long way. The latest version of the once-humble telescope will be going a lot farther – carrying us ever closer to the first light that ever bathed the Universe in which we live.

programme.title: The New Frontier - S02:E09 - Stars Above
programme.desc: Stars are a bit like human beings. They can be warm or cold, they come in all kinds of shapes and sizes... and, let’s face it, they can be dim or bright. And recent discoveries suggest that the number of stars in our galaxy alone, the Milky Way, may exceed 200 billion. Just what are these citizens of the night sky?

programme.title: The New Frontier - S02:E10 - The Dark Side
programme.desc: Perhaps that American politician was right. There are indeed things we know we don’t know. For instance, cosmologically speaking, we know we don’t know much – and certainly not nearly enough – about two of the enduring mysteries of the Universe. Dark Matter and Dark Energy, it’s little wonder that scientists are devoting so much grey matter and energy of their own to finding out as much as they can.

programme.title: The New Frontier - S03:E01 - Living with Space
programme.desc: How do astronauts cope with living in space? The unique environment, the lack of taste in their food and the smell of canned air all contribute to the stresses of living and working in space.

programme.title: The New Frontier - S03:E02 - Atmosphere
programme.desc: Climate change and pollution are having dire consequences for the atmosphere of our planet, this episode updates the latest technology and science looking into the health of our air.

programme.title: The New Frontier - S03:E03 - Flight Status
programme.desc: The latest updates on The New space hardware about to launch us into the next generation of space flight some rockets and capsules are on time others not so fortunate.

programme.title: Breakthrough - S01:E39 - Worlds Best Dinosaur Fossil
programme.desc: An extraordinary new discovery of a dinosaur fossil so pristine and complete, that it shows off the texture, patterns, and color of a prehistoric giant. Discover this brand new species that roamed during the late Jurassic and Cretaceous periods.

programme.desc: This is an inside look at NASA's groundbreaking Artemis Program, the spacecraft, and the people who will bring humanity one step closer to the moon, Mars, and beyond.

programme.title: Breakthrough - S01:E94 - Artemis II Ready for the Moon
programme.desc: Explore the rockets, landers, vehicles, and space capsule paving the way for future Artemis missions to the lunar surface. And meet the engineers—and the machines—behind NASA's Commercial Lander Payload Services (CLPS) missions, which are revolutionizing humanity’s relationship with the Moon.

programme.title: The New Frontier - S02:E08 - First Light
programme.desc: For an instrument first developed as recently as the 17th century, the telescope has travelled a long way. The latest version of the once-humble telescope will be going a lot farther – carrying us ever closer to the first light that ever bathed the Universe in which we live.

programme.title: The New Frontier - S02:E09 - Stars Above
programme.desc: Stars are a bit like human beings. They can be warm or cold, they come in all kinds of shapes and sizes... and, let’s face it, they can be dim or bright. And recent discoveries suggest that the number of stars in our galaxy alone, the Milky Way, may exceed 200 billion. Just what are these citizens of the night sky?

programme.title: The New Frontier - S02:E10 - The Dark Side
programme.desc: Perhaps that American politician was right. There are indeed things we know we don’t know. For instance, cosmologically speaking, we know we don’t know much – and certainly not nearly enough – about two of the enduring mysteries of the Universe. Dark Matter and Dark Energy, it’s little wonder that scientists are devoting so much grey matter and energy of their own to finding out as much as they can.

programme.title: The New Frontier - S03:E01 - Living with Space
programme.desc: How do astronauts cope with living in space? The unique environment, the lack of taste in their food and the smell of canned air all contribute to the stresses of living and working in space.

programme.title: The New Frontier - S03:E02 - Atmosphere
programme.desc: Climate change and pollution are having dire consequences for the atmosphere of our planet, this episode updates the latest technology and science looking into the health of our air.

programme.title: The New Frontier - S03:E03 - Flight Status
programme.desc: The latest updates on The New space hardware about to launch us into the next generation of space flight some rockets and capsules are on time others not so fortunate.

programme.title: Breakthrough - S01:E39 - Worlds Best Dinosaur Fossil
programme.desc: An extraordinary new discovery of a dinosaur fossil so pristine and complete, that it shows off the texture, patterns, and color of a prehistoric giant. Discover this brand new species that roamed during the late Jurassic and Cretaceous periods.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E41 - Fergie The Downfall Of A Modern Duchess
programme.desc: Sarah Ferguson, once known as the Duchess of York, seemed to have everything, but her world turned upside down when her name got caught up in a big scandal.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E42 - Diana A Model Princess
programme.desc: Diana's fashion sense was something people often looked at closely. She had a knack for picking outfits that were both stylish and sophisticated, which always grabbed attention. Her hats were another standout feature; she often wore elegant designs that added a touch of grace to her look. Her hair was also iconic, usually styled neatly with a slight bounce, perfectly framing her face and adding to her elegant appearance.
